notes: Major stability release after a full app audit: (1) Recording now checks the Screen Recording permission BEFORE starting and clearly explains what to do (instead of a cryptic error). (2) Long recordings now survive any number of system interruptions — previously they were force-stopped after 4 automatic recoveries (which cut meetings short). (3) After saving, the status now shows the file name — clear feedback on where your recording is. (4) Meeting mode can no longer be toggled mid-recording (it used to scramble your settings). (5) The notes overlay is now visible over full-screen apps too. (6) Mirroring now applies live in Presenter mode. (7) Teleprompter speed and font size can be changed while recording. (8) The camera bubble appears on the correct monitor for area recordings. (9) Double-saving (Stop + low-disk auto-save at the same time) is now guarded. (10) The update process no longer fails silently and relaunches the old version if needed. (11) The log file no longer grows without limit; several small memory leaks fixed.
